newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares slip, outlook pessimistic.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares slip, outlook pessimistic.

text.p: Slovenian shares slipped back on Thursday and traders said a continued stark absence of buying incentives could drive the index down towards 1,100 points over the summer.
* The SBI index eased 0.22 percent or 2.96 points to 1,315.96.
* Shopping centre operator BTC had the highest turnover, falling 1.96 percent to 14,500 tolars on volume of 1,799 shares for total turnover of 26.8 million tolars.
